messages:
zara: quick ping, noticed a 0.8% hole in daily aggregates for rollups in us-west for 2026-04-12T22:10-22:50. looks like some partial reslice failed.
pavan: do we have trace for the reslice job? which operator crashed?
deploy-bot: reslicer-service v1.4.2 deployed at 2026-04-12T22:05 to us-west. no crashes reported.
elliot: scanning logs now. pattern: a minority of partitions timed out during `group-join` step and emitted partial keys — downstream rollup ignored incomplete keys.
noa: can we target only the affected partitions and run a slim backfill instead of full reslice? less cost.
zara: yes, prefer slim backfill. want UX: show a non-blocking banner on the affected rollup dashboards: "Reslice in progress for recent window; numbers may update."
rachel: agree banner. also we should tag the backfill with origin=reslice-uswest-0412 and show in console job history.
pavan: safety question: are the partial keys causing duplicates if backfilled? need dedupe logic.
elliot: backfill will run with `dedupe=true` and `idempotency_tag` = origin tag. replays already support this.
zara: what's the cardinality? can someone post the scope query?
elliot: ran small estimate:
```sql
SELECT partition_id, count(*) as cnt
FROM telemetry.events
WHERE created_ts BETWEEN '2026-04-12 22:10:00' AND '2026-04-12 22:50:00' AND region='us-west'
GROUP BY partition_id
HAVING cnt < 10000; -- target small partitions
```
-- result: 18 partitions flagged (~72k events)
noa: 72k is fine. route plan: run slim backfill job scoped to those partition_ids, limit concurrency=10, cpu-quota=15%, priority-burst=12% for 40m. after that, run a quick aggregate check.
pavan: temporary router rule: if job.tag=="reslice-uswest-0412" then route->priority-burst. I'll add TTL 2h.
rachel: console: feature flag `console.replay_badge.reslice_uswest_0412` with banner text: "Partial reslice running (ETA ~40m)." will enable only for affected rollup IDs.
zara: ok start the job. tag origin and push to replay-scheduler.
elliot: queued job id=job-20260412-0101 owner=pavan tag=reslice-uswest-0412 scope=partitions:[p3,p8,p12,...]
elliot: starting job job-20260412-0101 shard=0/18 processed=0
pavan: monitoring: keep an eye on merge-latency and write QPS. throttle if write QPS > 18k.
elliot: progress logs `shard=2 processed=4096 deduped=4 errs=0`
noa: merge-lag steady at 120ms, write QPS 6.3k. fine.
rachel: badge enabled in console for rollup IDs abc123, def456.
zara: mid-run: 10/18 partitions done, processed=42k deduped=18. no 429s.
pavan: good. plan to run small postcheck: run top-10 metric diffs and ensure delta < 0.2%. if >0.5% we escalate to full reslice overnight at low priority.
elliot: final: job-20260412-0101 completed processed=72134 deduped=32 errs=0. reconciliation shows deltas <0.12% for all monitored metrics.
rachel: disabling priority-burst and removing banner flag after 30m. job visible in console at /console/backfills/job-20260412-0101
zara: follow-ups: pavan -> add router TTL safeguard to avoid long-lived priority rules, elliot -> add defensive timeout and retry on `group-join`, noa -> add console job link to incident note. I'll write short postmortem & share with product.
pavan: quick PR to router incoming: default expiry for ad-hoc priority rules = 2h.
elliot: PR to reslicer: increase `group-join` deadline and log missing-key-rate metric.
zara: thanks team. nice small scoped backfill, much less noisy than a full rerun.
